title: hybrid.rs: Panic on invalid prefix_len > 128 in MeshPrefix::contains
description: MeshPrefix::new (line 129) accepts any u8 for prefix_len without validation. If prefix_len > 128 (e.g., 200), then in contains() line 135, full_bytes = 200/8 = 25. Line 139 then accesses addr[..25] on a 16-byte array, causing an index-out-of-bounds panic. The check on line 144 (full_bytes < 16) only guards the remaining-bits logic, not the initial comparison. Add validation: prefix_len <= 128.
close_reason: Already fixed: MeshPrefix::new() clamps prefix_len to 128 via .min(128) at line 161, preventing out-of-bounds panic in contains(). Regression test mesh_prefix_invalid_len_clamped_to_128 verifies the fix.
